name: The Range (dev only)

do.objective: The pen is open and awake: nine creatures, fighting as in the game
The yard is awake: a Mother, two Bulwarks, an Acolyte, two singers
The vats are awake: kill a vat and its brood stops
The Warden is awake: stand west of the mirror and let the sweep find it

intro.title: THE RANGE
lines: Every weapon. Nothing runs out. You cannot die.
Targets stand where they are put. The second range is south of the hub: saw, rockets, gravity, a carbine lane.

messages.speaker: RANGE
messages.text: SPONGES, a metre from the wall (the harpoon pins them): they take everything, never fight, heal after 3 s. West to east: Tollbearer, Gaunt, Bellhand, Sexton, Gill, Warden, bosses.

messages.speaker: RANGE
messages.text: SWINGERS stay on their posts and face you. A Gaunt lunges, a Warden charges, a Bellhand tolls. Guard with a melee weapon (hold Aim), parry, then step to their side.

messages.speaker: RANGE
messages.text: FIXED targets never turn: blows land only in front of them. Walk round. Marlinspike into the back of the one facing north. One Warden faces you (plated), the other shows its back.

messages.speaker: RANGE
messages.text: CROWD: flare splash and burning ground, scattergun spread, the arc lamp jumping (hold to charge, it forks). They fall and stand up again after 5 s.

messages.speaker: RANGE
messages.text: WATER: the arc lamp shocks everything standing in the water, not only what it hits. Wading slows you too.

messages.speaker: RANGE
messages.text: SAW YARD: hold fire to rev; it cuts everything in front every 0.1 s and pulls you in. LOUD. Stalls after ~5 s of cutting; plate kicks it back (cut the Warden that shows its back).

messages.speaker: RANGE
messages.text: ROCKET YARD: 1.5 s a rocket, a wide blast, a direct hit adds more, bell nodes take double, plate does not turn it. It hurts YOU inside 65% of the blast. Corner barrels move.

messages.speaker: RANGE
messages.text: GRAVITY (key 9): hold RIGHT mouse within 8 m, near screen middle (the crosshair widens): lifts a crate/barrel/sack or drags a creature in. LEFT throws it, or punts if empty-handed.

messages.speaker: RANGE
messages.text: CARBINE LANE: sponges at 20, 40, 60, 80 m along the south wall. No bloom. A round in the top of the body is a HEAD shot (x2.4, staggers); the readout shows the last hit.

messages.speaker: RANGE
messages.text: MORTAR (key 0): the shell flies TO the ring, high, over the crates and up onto the ledge. Two rockets a shell, nothing inside 9 m, and the blast hurts YOU too.

messages.speaker: RANGE
messages.text: BREATH: the gate opens 4 s of every 8 and never shuts on you; the spore bed blooms 3 s of every 8 (it glows first) and burns and slows only then.

messages.speaker: RANGE
messages.text: ELITE YARD: a Bulwark takes 7% from the front and opens to bash. A Mother weeps pools and broods. An Acolyte wards: everything within 9 m takes half. The lever wakes the east.

messages.speaker: RANGE
messages.text: FOUNDRY YARD: a Brood Vat swells for 1.2 s, then drops a creature; kill the vat and the brood stops. Reeds shield the Grand Cantor. The west lever wakes the live vats.

messages.speaker: RANGE
messages.text: SKY YARD: step on a lit plate and you are thrown to its landing; steer a little in the air, shoot as you go. Miss the deck and the sky sets you back (15 hurt).

messages.speaker: RANGE
messages.text: GATE YARD: a Warden and two Seals to shoot. The lever wakes the live one: a 2.4 s tell, then a beam (pillars stop it; the mirror turns it onto the third Seal; no seals, no shield).

messages.speaker: RANGE
messages.text: LOADS: a container drops on the lit orange rect every 8 s (30 damage, it crushes a walker). The second lands four seconds after the first: cross between them.

messages.speaker: RANGE
messages.text: FOLK YARD: Vael civilians never attack. They watch, and run from a shot with the fan folded. The arc never locks on. A dead one is an INNOCENT: a rank cost (here they stand up).

messages.speaker: RANGE
messages.text: CURRENT: the channel pushes east and conducts the arc. FORKS to the south: fire a rifle and they ring and wake the two sleepers; a blow or the arc is heard from less far.

messages.speaker: RANGE
messages.text: SONGKEEPER YARD: a Zealot thrusts from 3.5 m after the lance dips and lunges across a gap. A hit GRAFTS: you walk slower for three seconds. Two sponges, two swingers.

messages.speaker: RANGE
messages.text: VAEL: Gills (the lamp stuns them), a bell node and a feeder (the lamp does double). The two bosses take less damage while a node stands.

objective: RANGE: sponges north, swingers middle, fixed south; crowd, water, Vael, pen east; the second range (saw, rockets, gravity, carbine) through the opening south of the hub
